sources.summary: A stone house embedded into the Greek landscape and a sprawling American home with a retractable roof are among the most popular houses featured on Dezeen this month. Also included in our monthly roundup of our readers' favourite residences is a white cube built inside existing brick walls and a timber home with tree-like columns. The post Dezeen's top five houses of August 2026 appeared first on Dezeen .
